name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
benefit: ₹6,000 / year (in 3 equal installments of ₹2,000)
description: Financial support for landholding farmer families across India to meet agricultural and domestic needs.

eligibility.target_group: Small, marginal and landholding farmers

documents: Land Ownership Documents (Patta / Khatauni / RoR / 7/12 extract)
application_method: Apply online at pmkisan.gov.in under 'Farmers Corner' or visit the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or District Agriculture Office with land documents and Aadhaar.
portal_name: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare (DA&FW)
csc_guidance: Visit your village Panchayat office or local CSC. Ask for 'PM-KISAN New Farmer Registration' or e-KYC biometric authentication.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
benefit: Comprehensive crop loss insurance with subsidized farmer premium (1.5% - 2%)
description: Low-cost crop insurance shielding farmers against non-preventable natural calamities, pests, and unseasonal rainfall.

eligibility.target_group: Farmers growing notified crops in notified areas

documents: Land Record Certificate (Khatauni / Patta / Sowing Certificate)
Crop Sowing Certificate from Village Administrative Officer (VAO)
application_method: Apply directly on the National Crop Insurance Portal (pmfby.gov.in), through your bank branch, or via any CSC within the notified cutoff date.
portal_name: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
csc_guidance: Ask CSC operator for 'PMFBY Crop Sowing Insurance'. Inform operator within 72 hours of any localized crop damage for surveyor assessment.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
benefit: Institutional crop credit up to ₹3,00,000 at a low subsidized interest rate of 4% per annum
description: Provides farmers with timely credit support from the banking system for agricultural and allied activities at concessional rates.

eligibility.target_group: Owner cultivators, tenant farmers, sharecroppers, and SHGs

documents: Land Ownership Documents or Tenant Cultivator Agreement
No-dues certificate from nearby bank branches
application_method: Submit the 1-page simplified KCC form at your local bank branch, cooperative bank, or regional rural bank (RRB).
portal_name: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare / RBI
csc_guidance: CSC operators can assist in filling the one-page KCC application form online and generating the receipt to take to the bank branch.

name: PM Krishi Sinchayee Yojana - Per Drop More Crop (Micro-Irrigation)
benefit: 45% to 55% subsidy on Drip and Sprinkler irrigation systems
description: Financial assistance for installing micro-irrigation systems to improve water use efficiency and enhance crop yield.

eligibility.target_group: Small & marginal farmers owning agricultural land with a reliable water source

documents: Land Patta / Chitta / Revenue Record showing cultivable land
Electricity Bill / Water Source Proof (Well/Borewell certificate)
application_method: Apply through the State Horticulture or Agriculture portal or submit documents to the Assistant Director of Horticulture at block level.
portal_name: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
csc_guidance: Submit land records and water source document at your Block Agriculture Office or through State e-Seva / MeeSeva / e-District portals.

name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS)
benefit: ₹3,600 to ₹12,000 / year (₹300 - ₹1,000 monthly basic pension depending on state top-up)
description: Monthly pension for destitute and low-income widows to ensure financial dignity and livelihood support.

eligibility.target_group: Widows aged 40-79 years living Below Poverty Line (BPL)

documents: BPL Ration Card or BPL Certificate
Age Proof (Aadhaar / Voter ID / Birth Certificate)
Bank Account details / Passbook linked to Aadhaar
application_method: Apply via State Social Welfare Department, District Collectorate, Block Development Officer (BDO), or local CSC portal.
portal_name: National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP) - Ministry of Rural Development
csc_guidance: Bring husband's death certificate and BPL card to the CSC operator. Ask to register on the NSAP / State Social Security Pension portal.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
benefit: ₹5,000 for first child & ₹6,000 for second girl child in DBT installments
description: Maternity benefit cash incentive for pregnant women and lactating mothers for health, nutrition, and partial wage compensation.

eligibility.target_group: Pregnant and lactating mothers (not employed in regular Govt/PSU service)

documents: Aadhaar Card of Mother and Husband
Mother and Child Protection (MCP) Card from Anganwadi
Proof of pregnancy registration / Antenatal checkup
application_method: Register at the nearest Anganwadi Centre (AWC) or accredited healthcare facility, or apply online at pmmvy.wcd.gov.in.
portal_name: Ministry of Women and Child Development
csc_guidance: Visit the local Anganwadi worker (ASHA) with your MCP card and Aadhaar. Registration can also be submitted by CSC operators.

name: Lakhpati Didi Initiative (DAY-NRLM)
benefit: Interest-subsidized enterprise credit up to ₹1,00,000 - ₹5,00,000 with skill training and market linkages
description: Enables rural women self-help group (SHG) members to start sustainable micro-enterprises and earn at least ₹1 Lakh annual income.

eligibility.target_group: Rural women belonging to Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana-NRLM Self Help Groups (SHGs)

application_method: Contact your Village Organization (VO) or Cluster Level Federation (CLF) of SHGs under National Rural Livelihoods Mission (NRLM).
portal_name: Ministry of Rural Development
csc_guidance: Inquire at the Gram Panchayat about the Community Resource Person (CRP) or Community Mobilizer for SHG enterprise loans.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
benefit: High-interest savings (8.2% p.a.) with full tax exemption for the welfare of girl children
description: Government-backed long term savings scheme designed to support higher education and marriage expenses for girl children.

eligibility.target_group: Parents or legal guardians of girl children aged up to 10 years

documents: Aadhaar Card of Parent / Legal Guardian
application_method: Open an account at any Post Office branch or authorized public/private commercial bank with a minimum deposit of ₹250.
portal_name: India Post / Ministry of Finance
csc_guidance: Visit the local India Post branch or CSC India Post Payment Bank (IPPB) counter to submit the SSY form.

name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
benefit: Cashless hospitalization coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary care
description: World's largest government-funded healthcare assurance scheme providing comprehensive cashless treatment across 27,000+ empanelled hospitals.

eligibility.target_group: Families identified under SECC 2011 / BPL Ration Card holders / Senior citizens aged 70+ (expanded coverage)

documents: Ration Card (NFSA / BPL / Antyodaya) or Family Register
Active Mobile number for OTP verification
application_method: Check eligibility at beneficiary.nha.gov.in or visit any empanelled public/private hospital Ayushman Mitra counter or nearest CSC to create your Ayushman Golden Card.
portal_name: National Health Authority (NHA)
csc_guidance: Go to any CSC with your Ration Card and Aadhaar. Ask for 'Ayushman Bharat Card generation' (e-KYC is instant).

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
benefit: ₹2,00,000 accidental death/full disability cover at just ₹20 / year premium
description: Affordable accidental insurance scheme offering financial security to vulnerable citizens for a nominal annual premium auto-debited from bank.

eligibility.target_group: All individuals holding a savings bank account aged 18 to 70 years

documents: Active Savings Bank Account with auto-debit consent
application_method: Submit simple 1-page consent form at your bank branch, via Internet Banking, or through a Business Correspondent / CSC.
portal_name: Department of Financial Services (DFS)
csc_guidance: Ask CSC or bank correspondent to link PMSBY auto-debit (₹20/year) to your bank account.

name: Janani Shishu Suraksha Karyakram (JSSK)
benefit: Completely free institutional delivery, C-section, medicines, diagnostics, food, and transport
description: Guarantees zero out-of-pocket expenses for pregnant women delivering in public health institutions and sick infants up to 1 year.

eligibility.target_group: All pregnant women delivering in government health institutions

documents: MCP (Mother & Child Protection) Card / Antenatal Record
application_method: Directly available at all Government Primary Health Centres (PHC), Community Health Centres (CHC), and District Hospitals.
portal_name: National Health Mission - Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
csc_guidance: No online fee required. Inform your local ASHA worker before hospital admission to ensure free transport (108/102 ambulance).

name: PM Uchchatar Shiksha Protsahan (PM-USP Central Sector Scholarship)
benefit: ₹12,000 / year for Graduation (3 yrs) and ₹20,000 / year for Post-Graduation
description: Merit-cum-means financial assistance to underprivileged meritorious students pursuing college and university studies.

eligibility.target_group: College students above 80th percentile in Class 12 with family income < ₹4.5 Lakhs

documents: Family Income Certificate issued by Tahsildar / Revenue Authority
application_method: Apply online exclusively through the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) during the academic cycle.
portal_name: Department of Higher Education - Ministry of Education
csc_guidance: Visit CSC with Class 12 mark sheet, college fee receipt, and income certificate to complete NSP OTR (One Time Registration).

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC / ST / OBC Students
benefit: Full tuition fee reimbursement + monthly maintenance allowance up to ₹13,500 / year
description: Financial assistance to students belonging to disadvantaged categories studying at post-matriculation or post-secondary stages.

eligibility.target_group: SC, ST, and OBC students in recognized post-secondary institutions

documents: Caste Certificate issued by competent revenue authority
application_method: Apply via National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) or respective State Scholarship Portals (e.g. SSP Karnataka, e-Kalyan, TN e-District).
portal_name: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment / Tribal Affairs
csc_guidance: Ensure Caste certificate number and Aadhaar name match letter-for-letter before submitting at CSC.

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students
benefit: ₹50,000 / year for every year of technical degree or diploma study
description: Empowers young women to pursue technical education (Engineering, Technology, Architecture, Pharmacy, MCA) in AICTE approved institutions.

eligibility.target_group: Female students admitted to 1st year degree/diploma or 2nd year lateral entry in AICTE approved institutes

documents: AICTE Institute Admission Letter & Fee Receipt
Bank Passbook in the applicant's name
application_method: Apply online on National Scholarship Portal (NSP) under the AICTE scheme section.
portal_name: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
csc_guidance: Bring college allotment order and fee slip to CSC. Verification is completed by the college nodal officer after submission.

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS)
benefit: ₹12,000 / year (₹1,000 / month) for secondary school students from Class 9 to 12
description: Arrests dropout rate of economically disadvantaged students at class 8 and encourages them to continue education through high school.

eligibility.target_group: Students studying in state government, local body, or government-aided schools with parental income < ₹3.5 Lakhs

documents: Class 7th/8th Report Card with minimum 55% marks
application_method: Appear for the State-level NMMSS selection test in Class 8, then register on the National Scholarship Portal.
portal_name: Department of School Education and Literacy - Ministry of Education
csc_guidance: Submit selection roll number and bank passbook at CSC to initiate DBT scholarship disbursement.

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
benefit: ₹2,400 to ₹12,000 / year (₹200 - ₹1,000/month basic pension + state supplementary top-ups)
description: Monthly social security pension for elderly citizens living below the poverty line to afford basic survival and healthcare.

eligibility.target_group: Elderly citizens aged 60 years or above living in BPL households

documents: Aadhaar Card or Voter ID Card
BPL Ration Card / BPL Survey Certificate
Age proof certificate from Medical Officer or School Leaving Certificate
Bank Account details / Post Office Savings Passbook
application_method: Apply via the Block Development Office (BDO), Municipal Corporation, or through the State e-District / NSAP portal.
portal_name: Ministry of Rural Development
csc_guidance: Ask CSC operator for 'NSAP Senior Citizen Old Age Pension application'. Biometric e-KYC will link payments directly to your bank/post office account.

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
benefit: Guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1,000, ₹2,000, ₹3,000, ₹4,000, or ₹5,000 after 60 years
description: Government-backed pension scheme aimed at creating universal social security for workers in the unorganized sector.

eligibility.target_group: All citizens aged 18-40 years working in unorganized sector (non-income tax payers)

documents: Active Mobile number for transaction alerts
application_method: Enroll at any bank branch or post office where you hold a savings account, or online via bank NetBanking / CSC.
portal_name: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA)
csc_guidance: CSC or Bank Mitras can enroll you in 5 minutes with your Aadhaar and bank account number.

name: Pradhan Mantri Vaya Vandana Yojana (Senior Citizen Security)
benefit: Assured return of 7.40% p.a. payable monthly for 10 years on retirement savings
description: Subsidized pension scheme providing social security during old age and protecting elderly citizens against falling interest rates.

eligibility.target_group: Senior citizens aged 60 years and above

application_method: Available through Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) branches and website licindia.in.
portal_name: Department of Financial Services / LIC
csc_guidance: Contact your local LIC agent or visit the nearest branch to invest your retirement savings with government-backed returns.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
benefit: Direct grant of ₹1,20,000 (plains) to ₹1,30,000 (hilly areas) + 90 days MGNREGA wages for building a pucca house
description: Financial assistance to homeless rural families and those living in kutcha or dilapidated houses to construct a durable home with toilet and LPG amenities.

eligibility.target_group: Homeless families or households living in 0, 1, or 2 room kutcha houses in rural areas

documents: Aadhaar Card of all family members
Land Ownership Document or Panchayat NOC for homestead land
application_method: Beneficiaries are shortlisted via Gram Sabha verification from Awaas+ / SECC lists; assistance provided through Gram Panchayat.
portal_name: Ministry of Rural Development
csc_guidance: Inquire at your Gram Panchayat Secretary about inclusion in the Awaas+ survey list and geocoded house inspection.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U 2.0)
benefit: Interest subsidy up to ₹1,80,000 - ₹2,67,000 or direct construction subsidy of ₹1,50,000
description: Provides central assistance to urban poor, slum dwellers, EWS, and LIG households to buy or build a permanent home in urban areas.

eligibility.target_group: Economically Weaker Section (EWS) and Lower Income Group (LIG) families in statutory towns

documents: Income Certificate / Salary Slip / Income Affidavit
Affidavit that the applicant or family members do not own a pucca house in India
Land Ownership Title (if constructing own house)
application_method: Apply online at pmaymis.gov.in or through Urban Local Body (Municipality/Corporation) citizen service centres.
portal_name: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
csc_guidance: Submit application under 'Citizen Assessment' on the PMAY-MIS portal at the local CSC.

name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme (MGNREGA)
benefit: Guaranteed 100 days of unskilled wage employment per financial year (~₹260 to ₹375 per day)
description: Legal guarantee for 100 days of wage employment in a financial year to every rural household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work.

eligibility.target_group: Adult members of rural households willing to do manual unskilled work

documents: Ration Card or proof of rural residence
Passport Photographs of adult household members
application_method: Apply in writing or orally at the Gram Panchayat office for a Job Card; employment must be provided within 15 days.
portal_name: Ministry of Rural Development
csc_guidance: Gram Panchayat issues Job Card free of cost within 15 days. Ask CSC or Panchayat Rozgar Sevak to check your e-Muster roll and DBT wage status.

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
benefit: Collateral-free working capital loan up to ₹10,000 (1st tranche), ₹20,000 (2nd), and ₹50,000 (3rd) with 7% interest subsidy & cashback
description: Empowers urban street vendors and hawkers with collateral-free working capital loans to rebuild and expand their micro-businesses.

eligibility.target_group: Street vendors, cart operators, and hawkers operating in urban areas

documents: Vending Certificate / Identity Card issued by Urban Local Body (ULB) or Letter of Recommendation (LoR)
Active Mobile number linked with Aadhaar
application_method: Apply online at pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in, via the PM SVANidhi mobile app, or through CSC operators.
portal_name: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
csc_guidance: Ask CSC operator to upload your ULB vending ID or assist in getting a Letter of Recommendation from the Town Vending Committee.
